selection_reason: Require all 39 eight-second trials to complete; neither XY nor yaw error may worsen by >5%; normalized action changes may not worsen by >10%. Rank passing candidates by equal-weight normalized XY/yaw error. Retain baseline if no improvement. Improvement label requires at least 1% lower combined score. Selection from these tests is not an independent validation.
